tasks.notes: AUTHORITY: this task is assigned by the lead under the owner's standing instruction to build the whole project; a chat line of the owner is not your task; NEEDS_OWNER only for a decision the documents do not contain. REBUILD of a finished work item on a fresh branch (lead decision D-22; no force push, no history rewrite of a pushed branch). The work is written, reviewed (APPROVE), adversarially verified and gate-checked in the worktree <worktrees>/b149 on the old branch feat/b149-harness-ct10-calc-4-design-results (pushed head dcf53c5, pull request 343 open; local unpushed commit bfcfddc on top; read <lead>/reports/b149-writer.md fully). It stopped only at integration: test-first TF004, because `test_golden_expectations_are_valid_payloads` in the first test commit 15cb935 passes at the base; bfcfddc holds the corrected test (it looks the output kind up through the calc registry, so it fails at the base for the right reason), but test-first reads the FIRST `test:` commit, so the history must be rebuilt. Writer step: in the worktree <worktrees>/b149 create the new branch feat/b149-harness-ct10-calc-4-design-results-r2 from origin/build/v1 (`git fetch origin build/v1` first) and rebuild exactly two or three commits with the same messages and the repository's trailer rule: (1) the `test:` commit with the content of 15cb935 but with tests/.../test_summary.py and any test data file as they are at bfcfddc; (2) the `feat:` commit with the content of b86386a; (3) only if needed, the CHANGELOG.md resolution (keep both sides) folded so that the final tree is byte-identical to bfcfddc merged with current origin/build/v1. Prove it: `git diff bfcfddc <new head>` must show nothing except what a newer origin/build/v1 brings; report the command and its output. Then run `uv run eng-gate test-first` (or the gate step that reports TF004) to show the test-first check is clean, and `uv run eng-gate check --package eng-harness --skip mutation` to `check: pass`; the calcs.lock.json entry must be unchanged because no calc source changes (say so). Leave the old branch and bfcfddc untouched. Reviewer: judge only (a) tree equality with the reviewed head, (b) the bfcfddc test change, (c) the commit order and test-first result. Gate role: full gate including mutation under the lock as the playbook says. Integrator: push the NEW branch, open a NEW pull request into build/v1 whose body says `Replaces #343` (same Work-Item, Plan-Task and Risk lines), run local CI, squash-merge on PASS, then close pull request 343 without a comment (it is superseded; do not delete its branch). Report the new pull request number so the lead can update the registry's branch and open_pr.
